code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6)
ax.set_title("Coop loading workflow - wash slab, door, aisle, racks")
ax.set_xlabel("plan view"); ax.set_ylabel("")
# room outline
ax.plot([2,8,8,2,2],[1,1,5,5,1],'k-')
# twin racks
ax.text(2.6,4.4,"left rack",fontsize=8); ax.text(6.0,4.4,"right rack",fontsize=8)
for y in [2.0,2.8,3.6]:
    ax.plot([2.3,4.3],[y,y],'k-'); ax.plot([5.7,7.7],[y,y],'k-')
# central aisle
ax.arrow(5.0,1.2,0,2.5,head_width=0.2,length_includes_head=True)
ax.text(5.15,2.2,"aisle",fontsize=8)
# door
ax.plot([4.4,5.6],[1,1],'r-',linewidth=3); ax.text(4.4,0.6,"door at grade",fontsize=8,color='r')
# wash slab outside
ax.plot([2,8,8,2,2],[0.0,0.0,0.5,0.5,0.0],'b--'); ax.text(2.2,0.2,"wash slab",fontsize=8,color='b')
ax.text(0.2,3.0,"crates\n20kg",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("sketch.png",dpi=150); plt.close()
